lines.text: A medieval legend says two green-skinned children appeared in an English village.

parts.tts: A medieval legend says two green-skinned children appeared in an English village.
parts.heard: A medieval legend says two green-skinned children appeared in an English village.

lines.text: At harvest time, villagers found a brother and sister beside a wolf pit.

parts.tts: At harvest time, villagers found a brother and sister beside a wolf pit.
parts.heard: At harvest time, villagers found a brother and sister beside a wolf pit.

lines.text: Their skin was green. They spoke a language nobody knew.

parts.tts: Their skin was green. They spoke a language nobody knew.
parts.heard: Their skin was green. They spoke a language nobody knew.

lines.text: For days they refused all food... except raw broad beans.

parts.tts: For days they refused all food...
parts.heard: For days, they refused all food.

lines.text: Slowly they learned to eat, and the green began to fade.

parts.tts: Slowly they learned to eat, and the green began to fade.
parts.heard: Slowly they learned to eat, and the green began to fade.

lines.text: Sadly, the boy was sickly, and died around the time of his baptism.

parts.tts: Sadly, the boy was sickly, and died around the time of his baptism.
parts.heard: Sadly, the boy was sickly and died around the time of his baptism.

lines.text: But his sister learned English... and explained where they came from.

parts.tts: and explained where they came from.
parts.heard: and explained where they came from.

lines.text: A land where the sun never shone, the light was like twilight... and everything was green.

parts.tts: A land where the sun never shone, the light was like twilight...
parts.heard: A land where the sun never shone, the light was like twilight.

lines.text: Historians call it folklore, or a garbled real event.

parts.tts: Historians call it folklore, or a garbled real event.
parts.heard: Historians call it folklore, or a garbled real event.

lines.text: So where did the green children come from? Nobody knows.

parts.tts: So where did the green children come from? Nobody knows.
parts.heard: So where did the green children come from? Nobody knows.
